description: This PHP class represents a detailed view of a Timesheet in the OrangeHRM system, encapsulating a Timesheet object along with associated row and column data, providing getter methods for these properties.

classes.name: DetailedTimesheet
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) that contains a Timesheet entity along with associated rows and columns for detailed representation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DetailedTimesheet with a Timesheet object, and arrays of rows and columns.

methods.name: getTimesheet
methods.description: Returns the Timesheet object associated with this detailed view.

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Returns the array of TimesheetRow objects.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns the array of TimesheetColumn objects.
